question: Which syllables and obeisance formulas are placed on the right and left sides?
premises: The right side receives ṇāṃ namo.
The left side receives yaṃ namo.
inference: Place ṇāṃ namo on the right side and yaṃ namo on the left side.
uncertainties: The syllable ṇāṃ may be a fragment requiring prior context.
plain_english: Place 'ṇāṃ, obeisance' on the right side and 'yaṃ, obeisance' on the left side.
